verdict.rationale: Review workflows with comments, approvals, and a merge step are a fair question for a documentation tool, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no review capability in Docusaurus itself. Mentions of git as a translation workflow and of local preview builds are external tools or adjacent features, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a technical writer, teammates propose changes that go through review — comments, approvals, and a merge step — before they publish
